class.name: BodyContactsSolver
class.brief_description: Moves a played clip's hand onto the same place on another body.
class.description: Holds a body's contact points (triangles of its mesh and barycentric weights, each corner skinned by up to [code]slots[/code] bones, set by [method set_points]), how each of its bones is read off a character's animated skeleton ([method set_skeleton], [method set_bone]), its torso's skin profile ([method set_torso]), its arms ([method set_arm]) and the spine bones that lean ([method set_lean_chain]). Each tick, after [method begin_tick]: [method place] poses a hand's contact point and its anchor on the animated pose, [method aim] sets the hand's target (the clip's hand moved rigidly by the miss) and the lean a target past the arm's reach needs, [method lean] turns the spine and carries the targets with it, and [method clear_forearm] turns a target about its contact point until the forearm to it is out of the torso, then finds the elbow's pole. Side 0 is the left, 1 the right; positions are in the skeleton's space.

method.name: aim
method.description: Sets the side's target: the clip's hand moved rigidly by [param miss], its contact point in the hand, and whether the arm reaches it. Returns the lean the target needs at full weight, radians, or 0 when it needs none, its anchor ([param anchor_bone], -1 for none) is carried by the leaning spine, or no lean up to the tuning's [code]max_lean[/code] brings it within reach.

method.name: begin_tick
method.description: Starts a tick: the bones' carries are read anew, and no target is carried by a lean until [method aim] sets it again.

method.name: clear_forearm
method.description: Turns the side's target about its contact point, by [code]tilt_step[/code] up to [code]max_tilt[/code], until the forearm to it sinks into the torso no deeper than the clip's own forearm plus [code]forearm_tolerance[/code], or as little as it can; then finds the elbow's pole ([method has_pole]).

method.name: clear_torso
method.description: Forgets the torso: [method clear_forearm] leaves the target as it is.

method.name: get_clip_forearm_sink
method.description: How deep the clip's own forearm sinks into the torso, metres (negative: clear by that much).

method.name: get_forearm_sink
method.description: How deep the forearm to the side's target sinks into the torso after [method clear_forearm], metres.

method.name: get_lean_axis
method.description: The axis of the lean [method aim] found for the side, skeleton space.

method.name: get_local_target
method.description: The side's hand target, skeleton space.

method.name: get_point_in_hand
method.description: The side's contact point in the clip's hand bone's frame.

method.name: get_pole
method.description: The elbow's pole [method clear_forearm] found for the side.

method.name: get_posed_normal
method.description: The normal of the point [method posed] last posed.

method.name: get_tilt
method.description: The turn of the side's target about its contact point [method clear_forearm] chose, radians.

method.name: has_pole
method.description: Whether the side's arm is straight or folded enough to need a pole for its elbow.

method.name: is_reachable
method.description: Whether the side's target is within the arm's reach, a lean included.

method.name: lean
method.description: Turns the lean chain by [param angle] about [param axis], each bone an equal share, on the animated skeleton's pose, and carries each target [method aim] set this tick with its anchor's bone.

method.name: place
method.description: Poses the side's hand point and anchor point: [the hand point, the anchor, the anchor's normal], skeleton space.

method.name: posed
method.description: Where the animated pose has contact point [param point]: each corner of its triangle skinned by its bones' carries, as the mesh is.

method.name: set_arm
method.description: Sets the side's shoulder, elbow and hand bones on the animated skeleton, the upper arm's and forearm's lengths at rest, and the forearm's skin radius (negative: no forearm check).

method.name: set_bone
method.description: Sets how base bone [param bone] is read off the animated skeleton: its [param index] there, the turn from that bone's rest to the skinned skeleton's, and the skinned rest's inverse.

method.name: set_bone_count
method.description: Sets how many base bones the points' corners name; each is unread until [method set_bone].

method.name: set_lean_chain
method.description: Sets the spine bones that lean, a chain from the hips up, by index on the animated skeleton.

method.name: set_local_target
method.description: Replaces the side's hand target, skeleton space.

method.name: set_points
method.description: Sets the body's contact points: each point's triangle and barycentric weights, each triangle's three corners, each corner's rest position, [param slots] bones and weights, and each triangle's rest normal.

method.name: set_skeleton
method.description: Sets the animated skeleton the poses are read from and the lean is written to.

method.name: set_torso
method.description: Sets the torso's skin profile (as a seated hands thigh's) and the bone that carries it.

method.name: set_tuning
method.description: Sets the tuning: [code]sections[/code], [code]sectors[/code], [code]profile_from[/code], [code]profile_to[/code], [code]reach_share[/code], [code]lean_reach[/code], [code]max_lean[/code], [code]forearm_samples[/code], [code]forearm_tolerance[/code], [code]tilt_step[/code], [code]max_tilt[/code], [code]near_straight[/code], [code]near_folded[/code] and [code]pole_out[/code].
